cards.text: Solomon, David's son, is the new king of Israel, and he's got his kingdom locked down tight. The LORD his God is with him and lifts him up HIGH. Then Solomon speaks to all Israel: every commander, every judge and every family leader.

cards.question: Solomon and the whole assembly of Israel go to the high place at Gibeon. Why Gibeon?

answers.text: God's Tent of Meeting was there
The ark of God was kept there

cards.text: That's the very tent Moses, the servant of the LORD, made back in the wilderness, and it's still standing at Gibeon. Meanwhile my edges went a little blurry and I got slid into the back of a JUNK DRAWER.

cards.question: The ark of God isn't at Gibeon. David brought it from Kiriath-jearim and pitched a tent for it in ___.

cards.text: But Gibeon still has the bronze altar made by Bezalel son of Uri, the craftsman God called by name to make the tabernacle and its furnishings in the wilderness (Exodus 31:1-11). It sits right before the tabernacle of the LORD.

cards.question: At Gibeon, where the bronze altar is, Solomon and the assembly inquire of the LORD.

cards.text: Solomon offers sacrifices before the LORD on the bronze altar at the Tent of Meeting: a thousand burnt offerings. A THOUSAND, friend, and I used to think two hundred cookies made a big day.

cards.question: That night, God appears to Solomon and says, "Ask, and I will give it to you!"

cards.text: Solomon replies that God has shown much loving devotion to his father David, and has made him king in David's place.

cards.question: Solomon is king in his father David's place. What does he ask God to let be fulfilled?
Solomon says God made him king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth. Then he makes his request. What does he ask God to grant him?

cards.text: Then Solomon asks, "For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?" Friend, I looked after six little cookie cutters on ONE counter and it took my WHOLE mustache.

cards.question: God tells Solomon that he asked for wisdom and knowledge to govern God's people, instead of riches or wealth or honor for himself, or death for his enemies. What else does God say Solomon didn't even request?
God grants Solomon the wisdom and knowledge he asked for, and says that's all He'll give him.
God says He'll also give Solomon riches and wealth and honor unlike anything given to the kings before him or ___ him.

cards.text: So Solomon leaves Gibeon, goes to Jerusalem and reigns over Israel. God said ASK, and the man picked wisdom, while I'd have asked for a bigger oven and felt GREAT about it.

Solomon gathers 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, with a horse and chariot trade reaching from Egypt and Kue out to the kings of the Hittites and Aram. The king makes silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, which is how sprinkles are in my bakery: EVERYWHERE, and I quit even looking down years ago.
